usedFor: Datawrapper builds charts, and “Create a Chart” and “Publish Chart” take your data to a live chart.

bestTemplate.name: “Product Updated” in Shopify, then “Create a Chart” in Datawrapper
bestTemplate.why: A product change is a natural moment for a chart, and the action creates it with a title and type.

watchOut: “When a chart is created or updated” is polling, so it fires after a scheduled check, including on updates.
